# Task title

## Outcome

Describe the problem and what should be true when it is fixed. Say whether it affects the CLI, the website or both, and which version.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The stated behavior or artifact exists and has been reviewed.
- [ ] Appropriate verification has evidence linked below.
- [ ] Required owner review and delivery are complete; unaffected surfaces are explicit.
- [ ] The next contributor can find the authoritative docs and latest checkpoint.

## Plan and dependencies

Link the canonical plan/spec and prerequisite Issues. Record a target Milestone only when agreed. State exclusions and the exact condition needed to unblock any dependency.

## Evidence and latest checkpoint

Link the PR/commit, checks, release/delivery record and latest checkpoint comment. Distinguish local candidate, merged, published and live. Do not use automatic PR closure for work that still needs delivery.
